profile.headline: Software Engineer @ Northrop Grumman
profile.summary:
Computer Science graduate from Occidental College. I have hands-on experience in full-stack web development, flight software engineering, and DevOps engineering from my work at Northrop Grumman.

I value working in teams with rigorous engineering practices and I'm eager to continuously grow as an engineer!

positions.title: Associate Software Engineer
positions.description:
∙ Perform requirements-based verification and regression testing for embedded flight software, contributing to software quality and mission assurance objectives
∙ Perform static code analysis using Coverity, investigating and resolving software defects to improve code quality, reliability, and compliance with secure coding standards
∙ Implement and unit test flight software code in C, achieving 100% code coverage and fulfilling software requirement specifications for several computer software units
∙Integrated Single Sign On (SSO) and TLS for 17+ internal websites, standardizing authentication protocols for increased cybersecurity
∙Deployed 20+ web applications to the internal company network using Docker Swarm, streamlining deployment processes via archived Docker images
∙Developed full-stack web features in TypeScript using the MERN stack, enhancing internal website functionality and user engagement

positions.title: Frontend Developer Intern
positions.locationName: Los Angeles, California, United States · On-site
positions.description:
∙ Contributed to the development of a website that will allow users to create virtual mentors via pre-recorded videos that simulate real-life conversations
∙ Enhanced user experience by developing custom ReactJS components using Typescript, ensuring a more efficient approach for users to address feedback of their virtual agents 
∙ Designed an algorithm to identify high-priority user feedback, enhancing feedback presentation for improved user decision-making
∙ Spearheaded automated tests using Cypress to catch and resolve bugs before deployment of new components, allowing for a seamless user experience
∙ Co-authored a published paper regarding the function of the project, which is to addresses the gap in access to STEM mentors for underserved student populations
positions.insights: Skills: MongoDB · Test Automation · Cypress · Git · JavaScript · Cascading Style Sheets (CSS) · Algorithm Design · JavaScript eXtension (JSX) · Software Development · Algorithm Analysis · HTML5 · User Experience (UX) · Web Development · Agile Methodologies · Database Design · Application Programming Interfaces (API) · React.js · Full-Stack Development

positions.title: Machine Learning Research Assistant
positions.description:
∙ Collaborated with student teams at Kean & Yeshiva Universities and a team member at Google Research in developing a recommender system for improved user health
∙ Utilized supervised non-negative matrix factorization to code an explainability model for the recommendation algorithm, resulting in personalized  explanations of the system's output for individual users
∙Programmed Python scripts to adapt CDC health data structures for compatibility with the recommender system, allowing the recommender system to be trained on different data sets
positions.insights: Skills: Machine Learning · Data Manipulation · Linear Algebra · Collaborative Problem Solving · Database Design · Python (Programming Language)

positions.title: Data Graphics Research Assistant
positions.description:
∙ Assisted in creating and obtaining images for a higher-education academic textbook
∙ Utilized Excel to track data and Adobe Photoshop to create data graphics for the textbook
∙ Obtained image copyright permissions from 100+ agencies and established contracts with them
positions.insights: Skills: Contract Management · Contract Negotiation · Microsoft Excel · Data Modeling

positions.title: YCC Crew Member
positions.description:
∙ Collaborated in a dozen public safety projects with underrepresented high school youth throughout the Angeles National Forest
∙ Distributed tasks to 12 crew members ensuring projects were completed on time
∙ Project example: Managed strategy for diverting water flows to not interfere with public hiking trails

volunteerExperiences.description:
• Facilitated English Language workshops to Spanish-speaking day labor workers at Pasadena Labor Center and facility workers at Occidental College
• Created lesson plans in advance and outreached for participants
